title: Mario's regression: a device pushed into his wrist

tellings.quote: And he bends my wrist backwards and he goes down into my wrist with it.

plain: Under hypnosis, an Air Force veteran named Mario Woods recalls that during a 1977 abduction aboard a craft, one of the beings bent his wrist backwards and pushed a device down into it. Woods, telling Michels what he says happened to him, puts it this way: "he bends my wrist backwards and he goes down into my wrist with it." If true, he was implanted or examined by whoever took him.
